notes.title: Update 1.1.5 - Trails!
notes.notes:
Hello fellow physics enthusiasts! I'm proud to release version 1.1.5, allowing an even more enjoyable experience.


[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[list]
[*] + Entirely new trail system! Trails now are randomly assigned a color allowing you to easily track multiple objects.
[*] + Application button toggles the default object spawn size.
[*] + Optimized shaders and performance of physics simulations.

[*] - Fixed a bug causing the player to not be able to grab objects.
[*] - Fixed a bug causing an object to get stuck on the right controller.
[/list]

Happy orbiting!
